## Change

Describe the behavior changed and the boundary it affects.

## Validation

- [ ] Changed native sources were formatted with the repository formatter.
- [ ] Relevant build and test presets pass on every affected platform.
- [ ] ABI manifests and C11/C++20 consumers were updated when required.
- [ ] Performance-sensitive changes include a representative measurement.
- [ ] Documentation describes the implemented behavior.

## Trust

- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO `Signed-off-by` trailer.
- [ ] The change contains no private captures, credentials, datasets, weights, or profiler artifacts.
- [ ] New diagnostics remain bounded and redact captured or recognized user content.
